00-aujourdhui: Today, we're learning to write the number five!
02-regarde: Look at the model, and follow the pencil.
03-depart: We start on the green dot, right at the top on the right. We draw the bar to the left, then we go straight down. And to finish, we make a big tummy to the right. Careful: the pencil never leaves the paper!
04-encore: Let's do it again, a little faster.
10-pareil: Did you see? It's always five, even when it isn't the same thing.
10-main: And five is also the fingers on your hand!
11-relance: Find something around you that there are five of!
12-va-sur: Find all our videos on eleveai dot fr.
